channel.title: Fire Engineering Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Fire Engineering Magazine (fireengineering.com)

item.title: Energy Hazard Training for Responders
item.description: Released in 2025, the Energy Hazard Guide (EHG) aims to help firefighters and responders better understand legacy energy systems. Chris Greene will discuss how to use it.

item.title: Enola (NC) FD Receives $20K Equipment and Training Donation from HEN Foundation
item.description: The donation included HEN structural and wildland nozzles, along with a full day of hands-on training led by HEN Foundation Executive Director and retired FDNY Lieutenant Ray McCormack.

item.title: Two Kayakers Pulled from Water in MI After Ice Collision
item.description: On March 4 in Grand Haven first responders rescued two kayakers who fell into icy waters after being struck by an ice shelf.

item.title: Lithium-Ion Battery Fire at CA Dorm Leaves 16 Rooms with Water Damage
item.description: A lithium-ion battery fire at San Diego State University displaced students in 16 dorm units, causing water damage and resulting in two injuries from smoke inhalation and burns.

item.title: Firefighter Injured, Dog Rescued in NJ House Fire
item.description: A firefighter was injured while responding to a house fire in Egg Harbor Township.

item.title: GA Bonfire Mishap Sends 15 Teens to Hospital
item.description: Fifteen teenagers were injured at a bonfire in Whitfield County after flammable liquid was allegedly thrown into it, prompting multiple airlifts to hospitals.

item.title: CT Apartment Fire Sends Two to Hospital, Displaces 11
item.description: A fire in a multifamily building on Jefferson Street hospitalized two people and displaced nearly a dozen residents.

item.title: NJ Building Explosion Leaves Four Critically Injured
item.description: A large explosion at a commercial building in Logan Township critically injured four people and prompted a shelter-in-place order for nearby residents.

item.title: Firefighters Pull Two from NH Fire; Woman Dies, Man Seriously Injured
item.description: A fire in a Wilton home left a woman dead and a man in serious condition.

item.title: Trump Fires Homeland Security Secretary Noem After Mounting Criticism Over Her Leadership
item.description: President Trump fired Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem amid criticism of her immigration policies and disaster response. He plans to nominate Sen. Markwayne Mullin as her replacement.
